description: This PHP class, ScheduledInterviewSummary, is part of the OrangeHRM system and provides a data transfer object (DTO) for summarizing scheduled interview actions within the dashboard's action summary module. It encapsulates candidate IDs, group information, and counts actionable scheduled interviews via an injected service.

classes.name: ScheduledInterviewSummary
classes.description: A DTO class representing a summary of scheduled interviews for candidates, used in the dashboard's action summary component.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a list of accessible candidate IDs.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the ID for the group this summary belongs to, here fixed as 5.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the group, 'Candidates To Interview'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the count of scheduled interviews that require action, using an external service.
